results.content: Alaska's numbers are less severe but still soft for a state he carried by 13 points less than two years ago. A Morning Consult tracking poll put his net approval in the state at minus 5, worse than deep-red Wyoming but nowhere close to the minus-41 Morning Consult recorded in Vermont. Civiqs data through early June put his approval in Alaska at 43 percent, disapproval at 51 percent. [...] Alaska last elected a Democratic governor, Tony Knowles, in 1998. He left office in 2002. The state hasn't sent a Democrat to the Senate since Begich lost his seat to Sullivan in 2014.
